communication.transport.telnet

Player connections: engine-owned menu/direct relays and worker-side Telnet protocol sessions.

Detailed Javadoc references open in a new tab.

Classes and interfaces

PlayerGateway
Engine-owned player listener: select a ready mudlib or attach directly, then relay bytes until disconnection.
PlayerGateway.Connect
Connection factory retains worker details outside transport.
PlayerGateway.Entry
Public menu entry; contains no runtime objects or administration authority.
TelnetServer
Private worker listener for one ready mudlib; public player admission belongs to the engine gateway.
